Guest Stars: Rooms.desc: Adds A-60, A-200, Bleach, and No Good to the roster. A-60 and Bleach work like the Angler, A-200 will pathfind to you, and No Good will attack if you open the next room's door too early, wait out his laugh.

Weeper.desc: Eden trees may spawn, break line of sight from them. If static fills your screen, you will be killed

Its you! its me!.desc: Coagulate spawns more often, if caught, you are controlled by it for 30 seconds.

Gone Fishin.desc: Adds Bobber Fish to the roster, stand still when its eye opens, can keep moving when not yet opened.

Kitty Clock.desc: Gives you the Kitty Clock, twist to wind back the clock, but twisting too long will break the key. Hit it when it screams, will drain your health while screaming.

Cereal.desc: Skinless Corpse spawns more often, and will deal damage when caught. Look away to make it disappear.

Always Eyefestation.desc: If Eyefestation can spawn, it will.

Enraged Eyefestation.desc: If Eyefestation can spawn, it will. Will also now start off Enraged.

NAVIgation Malfunction.desc: NAVI no longer keeps door count, except for in Heavy Containment.

Budget Cutbacks.desc: Tools last half as long, only use them when necessary.

Night Light: Off.desc: Watch your step, tripwires will no longer be lit up.

Art Portfolio.desc: P.AI.nter will block your screen with art, you can close his pop ups, otherwise they will disappear after some time.

DOORS STUCK.desc: Some doors may become stuck, kick them open.

Glue.desc: Drawers may require multiple tries to open up.

Wet Floor? All Clean!.desc: Puddles of Void Mass no longer leave puddles, and will no longer breathe, watch out for their eyes instead.

Butterfingers.desc: Equipping an item may cause it to drop, only equip one when necessary.

Squid+.desc: Squiddles anger faster, and will leave residue on your screen if they scare you.

Sitcom.desc: When taking any damage, an audience will laugh at you.

Freeze Frame.desc: When taking any damage, a freeze frame will block your screen, may trigger those sensitive to lights.

Restless Dreams.desc: Thick fog surrounds you, you cannot see more than a few feet in front of you.
